info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Trade Banking Credit Facility-spec
info.description: This API allows financial institutions to initiate credit facility agreements specifically designed for trade banking operations. By leveraging this endpoint, users can facilitate the creation of credit facilities that support their clients' international and domestic trade needs. Typical consumers include trade finance managers and banks looking to streamline credit provision processes. The API simplifies the management of trade financing arrangements, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and supporting client relationships.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new credit facility in the trade banking system. It requires necessary financial details and conditions to be provided in the request body, and it will respond with the created facility's details upon successful execution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a credit facility operation within the trade banking service. It requires specific information about the credit facility being requested, which is detailed in the schema. Please make sure to provide all necessary fields to ensure proper processing.

201.description: Successfully created a new credit facility.
